About Sustainabox

We built a home from three shipping containers on the Texas Hill Country. Not as an experiment, but as a real solution to the question: What does sustainable living actually look like when you're willing to do the work?

The Story: We took shipping containers, a piece of raw land, and 15+ years of enterprise resilience experience. We designed every system for efficiency, durability, and adaptability—even though we have municipal water, septic, and electric. The 20-foot container sits on a trailer, ready to move like a 5th wheel. We made mistakes. We learned. We built something real.

Sustainabox isn't off-grid. It's better: built WITH resilience principles but WITH modern comfort. No generator drama. Just smart design. And now we're opening it up—inviting people to see it, stay in it, learn from it, and understand what this approach to housing actually requires and enables.
